**Beta.** HACS only offers it if you enable beta versions for Awtrix Studio (⋮ → Redownload → Show beta versions).

### New
- **Layouts on the TC002.** On a TC002 running AWTRIX NG, a simple app can now use the whole 52 × 16 screen, one LED per pixel, instead of one line drawn at double size. Pick a **Layout** in the editor: **Value**, **Title and value** (the label in small letters above the value), **Value and progress bar**, or **Two entities, one per line**. The icon is optional, and a gallery icon is drawn at 16 × 16. Text stays legible: a light 6-pixel font for titles and lines, a chunky 8-pixel font for values. The preview shows the layout pixel for pixel.

Existing apps keep working as they are: they stay on one line until you pick a layout. An app with a layout imported on an AWTRIX 3 clock is shown on one line.

### Thanks
Thanks to the TC002 owner who asked for apps drawn pixel for pixel instead of at double size.
